Data extraction: .editorconfig INI dialect sections and settings

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"editorconfig\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("[*.rs]\nindent_style = space\nindent_size = 4\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
